picks.title: WGAE Partners With AI-Shielding Tool Cloak
picks.excerpt: WGA East members get free access to Cloak, software that makes documents unreadable to most AI models while preserving formatting for human readers.
picks.rationale: A concrete new protection writers can use right away: WGA East members get free access to Cloak, which makes manuscripts unreadable to most AI models while humans can still read them.

picks.title: 「LINEマンガ」、AIチャット「byUs」開始
picks.excerpt: LINE Digital Frontier (Naver Webtoon) launched byUs, an AI story chat on LINE Manga that lets readers co-create new stories with officially licensed manga characters.
picks.rationale: A new launch: LINE Manga in Japan opened byUs, where readers co-write new stories with officially licensed manga characters. It shows licensed character chat becoming a product in the Japanese comics market.

picks.title: Write a Novel in Thirty Days
picks.excerpt: A bookseller weighs whether to stock AI-written novels with clear labelling, as machine-generated fiction tests the shop floor.
picks.rationale: A working bookseller's view of whether to stock AI-written novels if they are clearly labelled. Earlier cards covered labelling from the publisher and certification side; this one is about the shop floor.

picks.title: Does the ROI of AI really only lie in corporate efficiencies?
picks.excerpt: Nadim Sadek argues the book industry should acknowledge that AI can bring genuine value to human creativity, not just back-office efficiency.
picks.rationale: A rare pro-creativity argument in the trade press: Nadim Sadek argues publishers should value AI for creative work, not only for back-office savings. It balances a week of anti-AI coverage.

https://ai.watch.impress.co.jp/docs/news.new_action: A new product launch: LINE Digital Frontier released byUs, an AI story chat with licensed characters, on LINE Manga in Japan (10-19). The 09-26 card covered Naver Webtoon's Korean character chat.
